needed.evidence: No footway visible on the left side of the road, people must walk in the carriageway
needed.suggestion: Install a continuous physical barrier sidewalk at least 1m wide along the left side of the road to separate pedestrians from motor traffic.

needed.evidence: The right footway is partly blocked by parked vehicles and other obstructions
needed.suggestion: Remove obstructions and ensure the right footway is clear and fully accessible for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: No footway means potential trip hazards in the carriageway for pedestrians
needed.suggestion: Install a proper sidewalk with smooth surfaces and adequate lighting to prevent trip hazards for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: The marked zebra crossing is obstructed and hard to see, drivers may not stop
needed.suggestion: Upgrade the crossing to a signalised crossing with a refuge island to improve visibility and ensure drivers stop for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: No dropped kerbs at the zebra crossing
needed.suggestion: Install kerb ramps at both ends of the crossing to facilitate safe and easy access for pedestrians, including those with disabilities.

needed.evidence: A wide road with a marked crossing but no refuge island
needed.suggestion: Add a refuge island in the middle of the crossing to provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait when crossing the wide road.
